p: night on my bed I sought: The Church by night, that is, in troubles, seeks Christ, but is not incontinently heard.
seek him whom my soul loveth: Showing that although we are not heard at first, yet we must still continue in prayer, till we feel comfort.
watchmen that go about the city: Which declares that we must seek to all of whom we hope to have any help.
wilderness like pillars of smoke: This refers to the Church of Israel which was led in the wilderness for forty years.
bed: By the bed is meant the temple which Solomon made.
in the night: He alludes to the watch which kept the temple.
daughters of Zion: All you that are of the number of the faithful.
crown with which his mother crowned: Christ became man, was crowned by the love of God with the glorious crown of his divinity.
